name: Azalea
notes: Designed by WY Lab on HMX's new L3 mold. Top is PA66 + 10% fiberglass, bottom is N1 nylon, stem is POM with ceramic powder. Force is unset until we know which spring: 42g/50g on a 20 mm KOS single-stage, or 45g/55g on an 18 mm one (UniKeyboards also sells a 45g bottom-out). Springs and stem legs are factory lubed, rails dry. Specs from UniKeyboards, Milktooth, and Keebpedia. Colors sampled from UniKeyboards photos.
